text:
maria: Quick help — HarborTrust procurement asked for SOC 2 + ISO artifacts and a vulnerability attestation for the POC. They need a deliverable package by Friday EOD. @ashley can you confirm what we can share and whether we can provide a signed attestation? cc @sam
ashley: We can share a SOC 2 summary (scope + controls matrix), ISO27001 scope doc, redacted KMS metadata (no key material), and a signed vulnerability attestation letter. We don't distribute raw pentest PDFs unless there's an NDA and explicit consent from the pen-test vendor.
maria: HarborTrust also wants KMS key origin and rotation evidence plus a list of mitigations for any recent high findings. Legal specifically requested a signed letter plus a rotation timeline sample.
ashley: Proposed package:
- soc2-summary.pdf (system description + controls mapping)
- iso27001-scope.pdf
- kms-metadata-redacted.txt
- vuln-attestation-letter.pdf (signed)
- cloudtrail-log-sample.txt (redacted snippet showing rotation events)
We will redact usernames, IPs, and internal hostnames. Include a one-line note explaining how to request full reports under NDA.
sam: POC ran in eu-west-1 on a demo dedicated instance. HarborTrust asked if we can commit to customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest during the POC and what the 6-month dedicated estimate looks like.
ravi: Quick ops estimate: reserved for 2x A100-class capacity ~ $45,000/mo list. Sales can offer a 20% POC discount for first 3 months with approval. Example calc:
```
list = 45000
discount = 0.20
effective = list * (1 - discount)  # -> 36000/mo for months 1-3
```
ashley: For delivery, recommend SFTP or presigned S3 with passphrase; avoid unencrypted email. I can prepare the bundle and upload to our secure bucket tomorrow COB and generate a presigned link with a passphrase.
audit-bot: Automated: soc2-summary generated at 1715554400 and uploaded to secure bucket (redacted).
maria: Please add a short procurement note that redactions were applied and the path to request expanded materials (NDA + vendor consent). I'll confirm HarborTrust's preferred transfer method and loop in legal if they insist on full reports. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
